rust_summary: client sound parameter interception before playback and live channel updates (`native_sound_play`).
doc_summary: `sound_play` intercepts actual client sound starts and live parameter updates. `SoundPlayback` identifies the instance, event, source, position, relative flag and whether it is starting. Edit base volume/pitch transiently or cancel before subtitles/backend writes; invalid edits cancel. No Host/world borrow or reverb/DSP is supplied. Runs on the game thread; use existing client hooks for world/acoustics state. Bundles need "hooks": @API:sound_play@.
